articleTitle: Prospect of Vocational Education under the Background of Digital Age: Analysis of European Union's “Digital Education Action Plan (2021-2027)”
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The rapid development of digital technology has a profound impact on the social economy, which is a significant sign that the society has entered into the digital age. Digital technology promotes the popularization and promotion of digital education while enabling education. Under this background, the European Union in 2020 issued the Digital Action Plan (2021-2027) at the end of September 2020, pointing out that the integration of digital technology and education is the general trend of the digital age. It is also pointed the development direction and priority actions for the digital transformation of education, and provides policy guidance for the digital transformation of vocational education. Based on the interpretation of the plan proposed by the European Union, and through the statistics and comparative analysis of the running data about vocational education in recent years, to discuss and combine with the digital education plan, the formation of high-quality and inclusive vocational education is in urgent need. Therefore, vocational education in the digital age need to constantly improve the digital capabilities of talents and promote the digital transformation of vocational education, so as to match the rapidly changing economics structure and the skill demand changed in the labor market.

articleTitle: Applied Research of VR Technology in Civil Engineering Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the continuous development, the virtual reality (VR) technology has been more and more widely applied to teaching. It is necessary to use the VR technology in civil engineering teaching. The VR virtual simulation teaching can be effectively implemented only through good teaching process design and teaching activity organization. When applied to the teaching process, the VR technology integrates various advantages in the aspects of teaching approach, learning style, experimental method, etc., but meanwhile, it is still deficient in technology products, teaching contents, etc.

articleTitle: Design and Function of Teaching Incentive Mechanism of University Teachers Under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Data analysis and application have greatly changed the teaching management and evaluation system and provided an opportunity for scientific management. This paper takes the way of teaching incentive of university teachers as the breakthrough point, expounds the improvement path of the teaching incentive mechanism of university teachers under the background of big data. The paper introduces key technology of big data in education, such as educational data mining and learning analysis technology, and at the same time designs a whole-process teaching incentive system for university teachers based on big data. The system is built on the Hadoop big data platform, using the column-oriented distributed open source database HBase as the database system. It carries on the distributed computation to the teacher's scientific research, the teaching administration, the personnel information, the examination reward and punishment, and provides the decision basis for the teacher, s teaching incentive. In the context of big data, positive incentives, such as teaching awards and salary incentives, and negative incentives, such as supervision and assessment, can effectively improve the teaching quality, further improve the teaching level, promote the education and teaching management in colleges and universities, and lay a solid foundation for the implementation of the fundamental task of cultivating people by virtue.

articleTitle: UAV Control in Smart City Based on Space-Air-Ground Integrated Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) is an important part of the wireless network system of the future smart city. As a difficult point in the large-scale application of UAV, UAV control gradually attracts people's attention. Aiming at the problems of UAV control in smart city application, a near real time online learning architecture of UAV control based on the software-defined space-air-ground integrated network (SSAG) was proposed. This architecture uses the two-layer software defined network (SDN) controller architecture of SSAG framework to separate UAV control. The upper-tier SDN controller is responsible for the scheduling of UAV configuration, while the lower-tier SDN controller is responsible for regional coordination of UAV. The upper-tier SDN controller updates the tendency of network states by acquiring network states information in time interval. By simulating the network state in the next time interval, the optimal strategy of UAV scheduling of the next time interval is obtained by using the strategy iteration algorithm. Finally, an example is given to verify that the near real-time online learning architecture can accurately predict the UAV requirement, and increase the throughput of the network system compared with the traditional approach.

articleTitle: Cosmetic safety risk assessment model and system implementation based on six-dimensional classification
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: It is difficult to manage the safety risk of cosmetics only by artificial feeling. The purpose of this paper is to establish an information system based on the cosmetics safety risk assessment model. which can automatically identify and quantify the safety risk, realize the risk grading and classification, and assist the cosmetics safety risk management. Firstly, based on the six-dimensional classification of cosmetic risk factors, a cosmetic risk index system is established by Analytic Hierarchy Process(AHP), and a risk quantification model is constructed. Secondly, a cosmetic safety risk supervision system with overall framework, database, algorithm of risk calculation and management process is designed. Finally, an implementation method and application case of the system is introduced. Practice shows this method and manage system has strong practicality and popularization value.

articleTitle: The Implementation Strategies of Smart Teaching in College Oral English Court Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the advent of the information age, traditional and single teaching methods can no longer meet the needs of modern education. Artificial intelligence, as a promising development direction of computing, has played a great role in the practice of teaching systems. This paper takes college English speaking teaching as an example and studies the role of FIF app in college English teaching to verify that artificial intelligence can help students correct their spoken pronunciation., improve teachers' teaching effectiveness and efficiency and increase students' interest in online learning, thus promoting intelligent teaching in college English speaking courses.

articleTitle: Research and Discussion on Key Technologies of Lightweight Smart Campus Based on LAPP
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the development and popularization of big data, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing, the digital and information development of campuses and education has become a common phenomenon. Smart campus is the development of traditional digital campus. At present, many colleges and universities are constructing and exploring smart campus. The lightweight “smart campus” based on LAPP is a unique campus system that combines manpower, equipment, environment, resources, and social factors on the basis of informatization to form a unique campus system. All information resources related to life services are fully integrated, interconnected and integrated, based on in-depth data mining and analysis, to provide comprehensive, effective and intelligent management and service process support for school work. Based on in-depth data mining and analysis, this paper analyzes and studies the lightweight “smart campus” system of LAPP from the perspective of construction and technology.

articleTitle: The Educational Reform and Exploration of Data Communication Technology Under the Blending Model of School, Enterprise, Industry and Education
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: This paper aims to analyze the existing problems during the teaching process of the course Data Communication Technology. Specifically, this paper will take the ICT integration between industry and education in ZTE as an example to explore the joint construction of “data communication technology” course between school and enterprise. Based on that, the idea of course construction will be put forward, which is meant to carry out project-based teaching practice by the MIMPS and reconstruct the teaching content. This not only optimizes the teaching method as well as the online and offline mixed teaching based on the BOPPS model, but also cultivates the communication technology talents with strong engineering practice ability and innovation capability.

Author Keywords: The collaboration mode of school and enterprise

articleTitle: Analysis on the Function of Computer Multimedia Technology in Contemporary Drama Stage Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In the era of big data, with the development and progress of science and technology, computer multimedia technology has become increasingly mature and gradually popularized in all walks of life, among which the application effect of computer multimedia technology in contemporary drama stage is outstanding. Contemporary drama stage performance is a kind of rigorous and comprehensive culture and art, which has strict requirements on stage design, display effect and visual experience. For example, the most important thing of drama stage performance is to highlight the inner elements of drama art and express thoughts and feelings, create a better performance atmosphere and provide better visual experience for the audience, so as to meet people's pursuit and needs for culture and art. The computer multimedia technology just combines the powerful functions of computer technology, which can comprehensively process various forms of multimedia information such as text, picture, video, audio, and transform it into an art form that is convenient to use and operate through high-tech technology, so that it can jump freely in various platforms in the form of art forms, and at the same time, it can switch and download freely between various paths. The application of computer multimedia technology in contemporary drama stage performance provides great innovation space and space imagination development for the expansion of drama stage. From the current application of multimedia technology in drama stage, performers are more concerned about the control of multimedia technology that meets the requirements of drama performance, mainly according to the specific requirements of drama performance, creating and designing audio, video and images, and controlling and transmitting them, thus enhancing the performance atmosphere, plot sense and audience's visual sense of drama performance.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Method for Street Lamps
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of urbanization, higher and higher requirements are put forward for infrastructure construction. Accurate fault diagnosis and timely maintenance of street lamps have become an important part of the lighting system. This paper proposes an intelligent fault diagnosis method for street lamps based illumination detection, narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) technology and machine learning. In this proposed method, the narrowband IoT modules embedded with the illuminance sensor are installed and numbered at the street lamps and the collected illuminance data are uploaded to the server to build the illuminance database. Then the machine learning method is used to learn the modes of the collected data sequences and the street lamp turn-on models are constructed. Further, the real-time illuminance data sequence is processed to realize the fault diagnosis and to judge the fault type of a single street lamp or lamp group, and then feedback to the maintenance staff. To verify the proposed method, one example is also given. The proposed method provides one effective way for fault diagnosis of street lamps.

articleTitle: Exploration and reflection on the application of mobile Internet technology in teaching practice of ideological and political courses in colleges and universities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, the application of mobile Internet technology in College Ideological and political education will be a trend of educational informatization. In this context, the research group combined with the application of mobile application carrier to make a systematic teaching design arrangement for the teaching practice process, and carried out relevant research, problem analysis and thinking summary according to the teaching practice. Combined with the questionnaire data and interview results, this paper analyzes the necessity, teaching methods and teacher-student roles of the application of mobile Internet technology in the teaching practice of Ideological and political course, and finally puts forward the conclusion: the application of mobile Internet technology in the teaching practice of Ideological and political course in Colleges and universities can improve the affinity of Ideological and political course on the basis of overcoming stereotypes, and live on the basis of paying attention to the teaching content. Based on the correct understanding of the role of teachers and students, the real-time interaction between teachers and students can be realized so as to create a new education and teaching culture of Ideological and political theory course and enhance the interest and effectiveness of Ideological and political course in Colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Pallet Detection Based on Halcon and AlexNet Network for Autonomous Forklifts
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Pallet detection is the key step of cargo handling for autonomous forklifts. Due to the influence of complex background, the recognition rate of pallet detection is low. In order to improve the recognition rate, a pallet detection method based on point cloud is proposed. In this method, time-of-flight (ToF) camera is used to collect the point cloud. AlexNet network which is provided by Halcon software is used for deep learning, and deep learning is used to extract the region of interest of pallet contour. The extracted region of interest is processed to obtain the regions of the pallet contour, and the pallet center is solved. The experimental results show that the precision of pallet detection can reach 92.0%. This method has high recognition rate in complex background, and has reference value for the design of pallet detection system of autonomous forklifts.

articleTitle: Object tracking algorithm based on fusion of SiamFC and Feature Pyramid Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Aiming at the multi-scale problem of full convolutional siamese network SiamFC, this paper proposes a target tracking algorithm of siamese network based on the fusion of feature pyramid network. In the network template and detection branch, the up-sampling feature fusion method similar to feature pyramid network is adopted to enable the algorithm to track on multiple scales and improve the network's discrimination of small target objects. At the same time, VggNet-16 network is used to extract the shallow and deep features of the image, and adaptive fusion of the two features. Experimental results on OTB2015 and VOT2018 datasets show that, compared with SiamFC, the algorithm proposed in this paper can deal with scale changes and target drift, achieve better accuracy and success rate, and improve the speed of model tracking.

articleTitle: Design of Multimedia Cyberspace English Reading System Based on Schema Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: This article is based on the principle of schema theory and attempts to explore the constructing methods of four mental schemas, including language, content, form and culture in English reading teaching. By analyzing its strengths and weaknesses, this paper expands the realizing forms of schema theory in English reading, and puts forward the idea and completes the initial design of a multimedia cyberspace English reading system based on modern cloud storage technology and multimedia platform. Through the analysis of input text information, the system can generate video files with the same context, realizing information association, map construction, symbol dynamics with the assistance of big data, and promoting the learners' sensory experience and comprehension ability in English reading.

articleTitle: Research on the Application and Practice of Continuing Education in College of Continuing Education Based on WeChat Official Account: —Guangdong University of Science and Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: At present, we have ushered in the era of rapid and vigorous development of new media. A variety of new media technologies are emerging in our lives, which are highly praised by students. How to combine student education with new media organically is a challenge for the Continuing Education College. In this paper, with the WeChat official account of the School of Continuing Education of Guangdong University of Science and Technology as the case, the fact that in the new era and the new normal, how the School of Continuing Education uses the WeChat official account to analyze the role played by the public account in a series of relevant measures to promote regional education is deeply analyzed.

Author Keywords: Guangdong University of Science and Technology

articleTitle: Research on the Characteristics and Guarantee System of Smart Library
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The development of the Internet and information technology makes it possible to form a smart library. The characteristics of the smart library are: personalized service methods; information resource sharing; service interaction; intelligent service content. This article discusses the security system and resource construction of intelligent libraries by using matter-element fuzzy theory. The system mainly includes basic network; hardware equipment; retrieval technology; and information security. Smart libraries can build characteristic resources and integrate shared resources. Continuous and in-depth research on smart libraries can provide readers with better and more personalized services.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Application Ideas of Electronic Information Technology in the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: As China's science and technology industry enters a period of rapid development, data collection and information exchange, as important tools, have become more and more important in ensuring the stable operation of the Internet of Things. Facing various deficiencies in traditional logistics transportation and management, we must optimize the data exchange and information flow in the development process of the Internet of Things by applying WiFi technology, RFID technology and sensor network technology. This is conducive to China's continuous improvement of logistics and transportation, positioning efficiency and project quality. First, this article briefly explains the importance and necessity of electronic information technology. Secondly, the author analyzes the current situation of the problems in the electronic order generation process, and further proposes the strategy of promoting the optimization of electronic information technology in the transportation network and promoting the intelligent logistics and transportation management. This will help ensure the development quality and economic benefits of communication technology and satellite positioning technology.

articleTitle: Research Blended Teaching Based on “Intemet plus”-Taking the course of computer network as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The appearance of internet plus accelerates the change of traditional classroom teaching mode. In order to better integrate online resources with traditional classroom and achieve the purpose of improving teaching effect. Taking the computer network course as an example, this paper analyzes the nature and objectives of the course and the characteristics of the students, and reconstructs the traditional teaching contents, teaching methods and teaching evaluation methods by using the online massive open online course, micro-courses and other teaching resources and rain classroom teaching platform. The practice results show that, this hybrid teaching mode combining online and offline not only improves students' learning autonomy, but also improves the teaching effect.

articleTitle: Research on the Innovation and Development of Internet Education Platform Based on SWOT-PEST Analysis Paradigm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The advancement of science and technology, the development of the times, the maturity of the e-commerce industry, and other factors have combined to give birth to the “Internet + education” model. Although the Internet education market has many brands and abroad market, there are still specific problems in the quality of courses, teaching models, interface design, and the profit model of most companies is not exact, making it difficult for companies to survive. Based on the SWOT -PEST analysis paradigm, this article interprets the development status of Internet education brands and the industry environment and proposes an innovative development strategy for the industry under significant data background.

articleTitle: A Study of English Course Evaluation, Satisfaction and Perception toward Virtual Learning Online from an Empirical Perspective
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Course evaluation is of great importance and significance in language education, especially in an era of internet technology booming. Language courses can be assessed from more dimensions with the aid of internet. This study probes to the evaluation of a certain English course, and surveys the satisfaction of the teachers who give instruction to the students based on the course syllabus. To make the findings scientific and convincing, this study takes an empirical approach to assess an English course conducted simultaneously in several Junior Middle Schools through different indexes and dimensions. The major instrument of research is online questionnaire and offline semi-structured interview. Validity and reliability of the questionnaire and the data collected online are analyzed through statistics software, such as SPSS. It is found that teachers are generally satisfied with the specified course and reflect an active and positive learning experience of their students. Meanwhile, teachers also show interest in the change of learning and teaching style, with great intention of a new “internet +” mode of virtual teaching and learning.

articleTitle: On the Difficulties of Traditional Paper Media in the New Media Age of Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology, the development speed of new media is rapid, the new media era has arrived, and the current Internet has become the main way for people to obtain information, which has a huge impact on traditional media. “The 17th National National Reading Survey Report” released on April 20, 2020 shows that more than half of adults tend to digital reading, and maintain a continuous rise, from 24.5% in 2008, increased to 2019 79.3%. For new media, paper media has a high cost, imaginary and interactive defects. Paper media should take up a place in such a situation, and must find the way to find their own development according to their own advantages and market factors. In the context of the Internet New Media Age, this paper analyzes the dilemma of paper media. It is a general trend to propose traditional media and new media. Finally, it is finally proposed that paper media should establish user stickiness and insist on the transformation strategy of the content as the king and innovative profit model.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Application of Computer Virtual Reality Technology in College Physical Education Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of science and technology in China, the emergence of computer virtual reality technology for college physical education teaching model has brought new opportunities. Therefore, on the basis of fully exploring the characteristics of computer virtual reality technology, this paper takes the feasibility and fit point of computer virtual reality technology in physical education teaching in colleges and universities as the starting point and courseware making, so as to provide an innovative path for the development of college physical education teaching.

articleTitle: Research on Double Tutor Group of Postgraduates Based on Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the continuous development of network technology, its application fields are becoming more and more extensive. Based on network big data, this paper analyzes the current situation of the implementation of the tutorial system under the background of the increasingly complex structure of professional degree graduate students and the continuous deepening of interdisciplinary integration. On this basis, this paper proposes a double tutor group training model, and proposes the construction strategy of the double tutor group model based on network technology. Finally, the exploration and practice of the double tutor group training model based on network technology in Hunan University of Humanities, Science and Technology is introduced. Research shows that the establishment of a postgraduate-double tutor group two-way selection system through network technology can effectively compensate for the lack of information asymmetry between teachers and students, and the use of the Android platform as a client is beneficial to the application and promotion of the system.

articleTitle: Research on automatic evaluation algorithm of subjective questions based on vector space model and synonym lexical forest
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Word2vec word vector algorithm and Doc2vec text vectoring algorithm calculate the similarity between words and between texts from the perspective of vector space without considering the semantic similarity between texts. Thus, in this paper, an automatic evaluation algorithm is proposed to combine semantic similarity based on synonym lexical forest and text similarity based on vector space. Meanwhile, Sentiment analysis was used to obtain the emotional score of the reference answers and students' answers in the subjective questions. Finally, the final score of students' answers was obtained by combining text similarity and emotion scores. In this paper, logistics professional education is the experimental object of the experiment. The experimental results show that the algorithm has achieved good scoring results.

articleTitle: The Reform of Design Education by Digital Media Technology under the Background of Information Technology-Take Gannan University of Technology as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous integration and development of modern information technology and educationrelated fields, the diversity of carriers presented by digital media technology, the convenience of information exchange, and the technological nature of technology have all contributed to design education in colleges. This article discusses that in the context of information technology, the design major of Gannan University of Science and Technology uses digital media technology to optimize the talent training plan, clarify the value orientation of the curriculum system structure, adjust the proportion of digital curriculum practice teaching, and establish a digital talent experimental area and information technology. In terms of teaching reform and other aspects, it is discussed to make design professional education take an innovative and applicationoriented path in design professional education, Through interdisciplinary joint training of talents, implementation of a digital national strategy, formation of a multi-disciplinary cluster of scientific research atmosphere, use of information teaching to enrich teaching methods, and integration of digital technology into traditional culture, red culture and other forms to promote the transformation of traditional liberal arts education.

articleTitle: The Function and Core Analysis of the Application of Virtual Reality Technology in Ideological and Political Practice Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Under the background of the continuous improvement of science and technology, the operation mode of the education field has undergone earth-shaking changes on this basis. Among them, the advanced technology of virtual reality has gradually been integrated into the teaching field of colleges and universities, and can help teachers to fundamentally improve the efficiency of ideological and political education, allowing students to deeply perceive the core of ideological and political courses in a series of virtual environments Connotation, students can deeply experience the fun of learning ideological and political courses in this teaching process. Not only that, college ideological and political teachers can also use this advanced technology to realize the virtualization of teaching time and space, creating more splendid virtual teaching environments for students, so that students can truly experience the practical curriculum in a more novel learning environment. It has important value, and needs to pay attention to the main position of students in the classroom, so that teachers can learn more about the problems that students have in the past learning state, so that they can formulate a more complete teaching plan and be more flexible The use of virtual reality technology makes the content of the courses at each stage more interesting. This article analyzes and summarizes the current teaching methods of ideological and political courses, and proposes some feasible teaching concepts, aiming to help more college teachers to actively use their spare time to study the application of virtual reality technology and reshape the original Ideological and political classroom.

articleTitle: Analysis on Ideological and Political Education for Poverty-Stricken College Students Based on Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Under the current network environment, the methods of student education must be adjusted to new times. It is extremely important to put the ideological and political education to college poverty-stricken students which is a disadvantaged group among college students. New network technology needs to be combined with the political education in student teaching and management, so as to remedy limitation of traditional education methods. This study discusses the current status and possible challenges of political education in poverty-stricken student management under network environment, then put forward some useful suggestions to help poverty-stricken students obtain sustainable development.

articleTitle: Research on the Structure of College Students' Learning Network Based on Community Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The learning process of college students is interactive. A learning network is a kind of social network established in the learning process and guided by the acquisition of knowledge and information transmission. This article was based on the community theory and discussed the college students' learning network, and built a model of the college students' learning network structure.

articleTitle: Research on the path of craftsman spirit cultivation education of science and Engineering College Students under the background of information technology integration
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In order to make college students have higher quality and responsibility after graduation, it is a favorable measure to integrate “craftsman spirit” into the ideological and political education of colleges and universities by means of informatization. In order to better cultivate students' craftsman spirit, this paper discusses the significance, feasibility and path of cultivating students' craftsman spirit in the form of data analysis.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of “Internet” Mental Health Cloud Platform Based on Trinity Model Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the rapid pace of life in today's society, adult pressure is generally greater. Due to the lack of a series of psychological communication and the influence of work pressure, Chinese adults have derived a series of unhealthy psychology. The construction and application of “Internet” mental health cloud platform is very important. At present, the psychological circle of China also appears the idea of constructing a kind of wisdom cloud platform. This paper will focus on the impact of the Internet in today's mental health, components, architecture and mental health cloud platform construction technology functional model. This paper attempts to design and transform the mental health cloud platform, and makes the future development route and direction of mental health from the network level.

articleTitle: Research on Blue Ink Cloud Classroom Platform and its Application in Teaching Proe Course
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The computer 3D design Proe software course is a compulsory course for industrial design majors. In the traditional teaching, there are problems such as low student initiative, single teaching method, low student motivation and narrow student knowledge. The development of mobile Internet and the popularity of mobile smart devices have made “Internet+” teaching a trend and mobile learning a new way of online learning. This article combines the characteristics of the Proe course, analyses the design of the teaching process framework, implementation methods and so on, and studies the mobile learning mode based on the Blue Ink Cloud Mobile Learning App; the article shows that the method can effectively solve the problems existing in Proe teaching and achieve good teaching implementation results from the statistical analysis of the proportion of resources acquired and the overall activity participation.

articleTitle: Research on Sports and Health Education for College Students in the Internet Era—Taking Media Integration as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In recent years, the explosive development of the Internet is obvious, and college students are relying more on media products such as mobile phones and computers. With the popularity of the Internet, physical health problems of the college students also come along, and their physical health levels are not optimistic. Therefore, it is urgent to implement sports health education. So, in the times of healthy China and national fitness, this paper takes the strengthening of students' physical health as the guidance and the promoting of sports participation as the main idea to come up with a positive innovation way of education in the era of media integration, whose propose is promoting the overall and healthy development of college students with the new sports and health education by the means of literature combing and action research and so on. The conclusions are as follows: (1) build a platform for the exchange of sports health knowledge to realize the on-line and off-line common education through the media technology; (2) making a sports campus atmosphere and form a health community; (3) making a live broadcast platform for campus to promote the sports events of school. All this can stimulate students' interest in sports and cultivate their health consciousness.

articleTitle: Discussion on Time Teaching of Graphic Design Course in Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the development of economy in recent years, China has made remarkable improvement in the field of big data, people's life in all fields has not been far from data technology, in the application, big data has gradually changed people's life footprint, life bit by bit has become scientific and intelligent, whether in work or life, big data has become an essential tool. This paper aims at the background of big data, studies the discussion of graphic design, understands the basic concept of graphic design and big data, the influence of big data on graphic design and the technical reform of graphic design under the background of big data. Through the case analysis, this paper makes a thorough study and discussion, obtains the relevant theory to carry on the prevention and provides the powerful basis for Chinese education reform.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Study on Integration of Ideological, Political Courses into Art Curriculum of Higher Vocational Colleges Under ‘Intenet+’
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the support of Internet technology, more and more information technology has begun to be introduced into course teaching. The teaching of art majors in higher vocational colleges is no longer the addition of teaching materials to students and teachers. Multi-integrated teaching method such as students, teachers, teaching materials and Internet education technology can greatly improve the teaching effect of the courses. What kind of talents to train, how to train talents, and the positioning of talents are needed to be constantly considered by those engaged in the education industry. The ideological and political course proposed is mainly to solve the above three problems. All majors in higher vocational colleges can effectively improve the effectiveness and correctness of talent training through the integration of courses for ideological and political education into professional teaching. Based on this, the article conducts research on the integration of courses for ideological and political education into the art curriculum under the technical means of ‘Internet +’. Firstly, it briefly elaborates the current situation of the integration of curriculum ideology and politics into the teaching of art courses under the background of the ‘Internet+’. Then, based on the problems existing in the integration of ideological and political teaching into the art curriculum, a targeted strategy to improve the effectiveness of the ideological and political integration of the curriculum is proposed, and it is expected to be beneficial to relevant practitioners.

Author Keywords: courses for ideological and political education

articleTitle: Reform and Implementation of Engineering training in Universities Based on Intelligent Manufacturing Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Intelligent manufacturing technology has been widely implemented in modern enterprises, and it puts forward higher requirements for engineering ability of college graduates. Engineering training is an important practice to cultivate students' engineering ability in Colleges and universities. In this paper, the concept of product PLM and MES are applied to the practical teaching activities of engineering training. Taking the project as the carrier, the workflow based on Windchill platform as the drive, and the students as the main body, a set of reforms are established in engineering training. First, it was implemented product data management platform to manage the whole engineering data during education process. Second, an equipment management system and warehouse management software are established, which not only enables students to combine knowledge with practical application, but also improves the efficiency level of information management. Meanwhile, environmental management system, occupational health and safety management system commonly used in enterprises are deeply integrated with engineering training and teaching activities. The environment and safety network monitoring platform is established, so that students can not only understand the environmental status at any time, but also identify the hazard sources and risk prevention and control methods, So as to enhance the students' subjective initiative and engineering capability.

articleTitle: New Media Communication Research of “Dingxiang Doctor”
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Equipped with mass market, social convenience and huge communications, Wechat has been the major channel of information in the new era. WeChat official subscriptions, due to the strong platform, are indispensable for health distribution. How to maximize platform advantages for better health dissemination effect has become debated. Comprehending the communication strategy holds key to the health enterprises, and even to improve the health awareness of the whole society. The official subscription of “Dingxiang Doctor”, an influential health knowledge medium, is selected for case study in the paper. Its 264 articles, published from July 1 to 31, 2019, are utilized as samples to analyze its communication effect and strategy. Communication effect mainly refers to the changes made by the audience in the four progressive stages of knowledge, emotion, attitude and behavior after receiving information. As the emerging media, WeChat official subscriptions know that the cognitive situation corresponds to the communication breadth, and the attitude and emotion transformation corresponds to the communication depth, with reads and likes as the specific evaluation indicator respectively. In terms of the communication breadth, the paper analyzes the strategy from the article position (headline and non-headline), title setting (expression and entertainment) and section setting (classification and subdivision), as well as the ranking of reads (total, highest and average reads). With regard to communication depth, it illustrates from multimedia usage (general picture and text, cartoons, audio and video), content science (the mark of scientific review) and topic selection and classification (health care, nutritious diet, disease prevention, etc.), as well as likes (total, highest and average likes). All of these are to bring forth suggestions to improve the health dissemination. Data analysis of the sample from “Dingxiang Doctor” conveys that, for communication breadth, the headline, and the enticing, emphatic and entertaining topic have higher reads. Additionally, compared to the interactive content, the promotion has higher reads, and the marketing highest. In terms of communication depth, the audio and video compared with the general picture and text have higher reads, and the cartoon has highest ones. Whether the articles are located in the front page or not, those marked with scientific review have higher likes. The topics closely related to readers' daily life also have a higher likes. The following strategies can be adopted to enhance health communication. Firstly, attention should be paid the headline role and the exquisite content, title and presentation. Secondly, the title should be eye-catching and engaging, and the plate classification should be concise and reasonable. Thirdly, the topic should be interconnected with life, content ought to be scientific and authoritative, and presentation is supposed to be rich and varied. These strategies allow the serious and boring science to be easily understood. In this way, they can help editors with scientific and entertaining articles for cultivating the proper health awareness of the audience.

articleTitle: The Role of Computer Internet in the Management of College Students' Education
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In the information age, the development and application of Internet technology has spread all over the industry and field. The timeliness, sharing and openness of Internet technology have a great influence on the thinking, learning and life style of contemporary college students. Because Internet technology has great advantages in information dissemination and storage, the types and ways of information that students can contact through the Internet are becoming more and more diversified. This also increases the difficulty of college students' education management. Therefore, this paper analyzes the influence of contemporary Internet technology on college students from the characteristics of Internet technology. On this basis, this paper combs out some achievements brought by computer Internet in the education management of college students, and at the same time, in order to strengthen and perfect the education management of college students, this paper puts forward some suggestions for improvement.

articleTitle: Research on the Development of Dance Education in Colleges and Universities under the Background of Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the rapid popularization of the Internet, the Internet has slowly moved to the classroom, and the network teaching has gradually approached the university, which has become an important way for college students to learn. This paper first discusses the influencing factors of the development of dance education in colleges and universities, and analyzes many problems faced by dance education in colleges and universities. At the same time, this paper combs out college students' cognition of dance education in colleges and universities under the background of “Internet”, and summarizes the role of” Internet “in dance education in colleges and universities. Finally, this paper discusses the development path of dance education in colleges and universities from the perspective of teaching input, teaching content and teaching platform.

Author Keywords: Dance Education in Colleges and Universities

articleTitle: Analysis of Computer-Aided Teaching of Dance under Product
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the gradual development of information campus construction, how teachers use information technology to improve the quality of dance teaching is a problem that should be considered by dance teaching reform and teachers. Therefore, this paper expounds the relevant connotation of the product through the way of literature research, and deeply analyzes the problems in the creation and dissemination of dance tutorials in China today. Based on this, this paper puts forward the development trend of dance computer-aided teaching under the product from the perspective of the construction of the product library. Colleges and universities can further innovate and develop dance teaching by equipping dance classrooms suitable for CAI, popularizing integral teaching ideas, and actively setting up research and development teams.

articleTitle: Research on the Design and Effect of Audiovisual Elements in Online Course Videos
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The impact of the epidemic has caused a rapid increase in online video courses, followed by the construction of multi-level and multi-channel online courses. Online courses are a systematic project involving multiple links. Judging from the current online course form, the shooting techniques range from amateur to professional, from single to diverse, from simple to complex, and the production skills are more abundant. All-round improvement and development in shooting mode, scene selection, post-production, etc., improved the audio-visual effects of online courses, and relatively improved teaching effects, which played a positive role in promoting the construction of college video courses. This article analyzes the audiovisual elements of online courses, one of the content of teaching resources. Different audiovisual elements play different roles in online courses and have different effects on teaching effects.

articleTitle: Data-driven mixed teaching of financial investment courses based on OBE concept to improve learning effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The OBE education philosophy, which is student-oriented, results-oriented, and continuous improvement as an optimization means, is becoming a new paradigm of applied higher education. On the practical level, blended teaching based on information technology has become a hot issue in teaching reform. Under this background, starting from the characteristics of financial investment courses, this paper explores the application of blended teaching in financial investment courses in application-oriented universities. By introducing OBE teaching concept, traditional classroom teaching, classroom teaching and online learning modes are organically integrated, and the emphasis of teaching is on stimulating students' learning motivation, making students' passive learning become active learning, training students' learning efficiency by data driving, and making advanced concepts and advanced teaching modes help each other.

articleTitle: Research on Parallel Computing Algorithm in Internet of Things System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The parallel computing algorithm is applied to the application layer of the Internet of things, which aims to improve the computing speed, expand the scale of problem solving and solve the large and complex computing problems of the Internet of things system. Parallel computing can be divided into time parallel and spatial parallel. Time parallelism is pipeline technology, while spatial parallelism refers to the concurrent execution of computation with multiple processors to reduce the time needed to solve complex problems. The software platform of the application layer of the Internet of things is built, the window structure of the application layer of the Internet of things is established, and the complex and diverse programming methods of parallel computing are completed in the application layer of the Internet of things. By using parallel algorithm and parallel programming, some complex computing is transformed into simple calculation which satisfies the accuracy through algorithm analysis. Parallel computing algorithm is used in Internet of things, and many kinds of computing resources are used to solve the computing problems, and the computing speed and data processing ability of Internet of things system are improved.

articleTitle: Research on the Innovation and Development of Environmental Design Curriculum in the Context of Informatization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The continuous innovation of information technology brings opportunities for the development of various industries in the country, but also makes them face great reform challenges. Under the background of information technology, various modern mechanical equipment and design software appear in the field of environmental design, which makes the personnel training and curriculum of environmental design major face certain challenges. On the one hand, information design software and modern technology can help environmental design practitioners to design more modern, environmental protection and aesthetic works. However, on the other hand, colleges and universities should draw close to information to a certain extent in the training of talents and curriculum system of environmental design specialty, so that students can master the modern technology needed by the industry, which is a huge problem facing colleges and universities at present. Therefore, starting with the development trend of environmental design specialty, this paper deeply analyzes the specific requirements of environmental design specialty under the background of information technology, and discusses the potential problems in environmental design teaching and curriculum setting combined with the characteristics of environmental design specialty. Finally, the development path of curriculum innovation is discussed.

articleTitle: Exploration on the implementation path of ideological and political education in colleges from the perspective of “Internet +”
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The development of Internet technology is the product of information technology, and the Internet has promoted the development of many aspects of society. With the rapid development of the Internet, colleges and universities should actively introduce Internet technology to promote the construction of ideological and political education. Based on the influence of Internet on ideological and political education in colleges and universities, this paper analyzes the present situation of ideological and political education in colleges and universities. At the same time, combined with the new characteristics of students' learning in the Internet era, this paper reveals the guiding role of the Internet in ideological and political education in colleges and universities. On this basis, this paper puts forward the development ideas of ideological and political education in colleges and universities with network platform integration, classroom education as the main and idea innovation. Through the above research, this paper will provide a reference for the further improvement and development of ideological and political education in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Study of Intercultural Communication Training in Interpreting Teaching Based on Multimedia Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the vigorous development of social economy and the iterative update of electronic terminals, the multimedia technology is becoming more and more mature, which has played increasingly important role in human's life and learning. In modern interpreting teaching with intercultural communication training, trainers have expanded the teaching methods by organically combining multimedia technology with curriculum theory effectively. Based on analysis of intercultural characteristics of interpretation in the combination with multimedia technology, this study proposes three training patterns of intercultural communication in process of interpreting teaching, by means of discussing the influential factors of multimedia technology in intercultural communication training on current interpreting teaching.

articleTitle: Research on Talent Training of Intelligent Manufacturing Specialty Group Based on Campus Productive Training Base under the Background of Informatization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Based on the fact that information technology will continue to be used in manufacturing projects and promote the development of Intelligent Manufacturing Engineering, this paper studies the application of information technology in intelligent manufacturing education. With the transformation of many enterprises towards intelligent manufacturing, the informatization of manufacturing industry, the virtualization of physical resources and the intellectualization of production process are developing continuously. More and more enterprises pay attention to the informatization and intellectualization of manufacturing industry. This paper takes the intelligent manufacturing productive training base as the carrier of deepening the integration of production and education, and combines the education supply and industrial demand of Intelligent Manufacturing Talents in China to study the cultivation and research of talents in higher vocational colleges, so as to serve the regional economic development.

articleTitle: A Study on the Teaching Design of Research on the Teaching Design of Foreign Language Classroom in Colleges and Universities in the Era of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of social economy, science and technology have also made great progress. Artificial intelligence and other advanced technologies continue to flow out, and has been widely used in various fields of society. Its application in the field of education compared with the traditional teaching methods have a more significant positive impact. We should make full use of artificial intelligence technology in the field of teaching to give full play to its role and promote the development and reform of education. Basically, we serve people through computing and data. Therefore, according to the teaching design of foreign language classroom in colleges and universities, the new requirements of ideological and political education in China, combined with the results of the blended teaching reform in our school, and taking the main course of Japanese Audio-Visual and Oral (3) as an example, this paper points out that teachers should strengthen their self-cultivation and explore the elements of content education. From the aspect of curriculum standard, we should refine the curriculum and perfect the evaluation standard. It is necessary to establish the resource base of artificial intelligence autonomous learning, explore the instructional design of strengthening the consciousness of autonomous learning, and integrate the ideological and political education ideas with the elements of artificial intelligence education in classroom instructional design.

articleTitle: Research on the construction of teaching resource platform in China's higher vocational colleges based on the perspective of the Internet platform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Using Internet technology, the professional teaching model based on the “Internet + Education” platform has become a craze and trend of teaching. The article first analyzes the teaching problems in China's higher vocational colleges, and then from the perspective of the combination of Internet technology and education, it discusses the construction of teaching resources, the construction of professional teaching online open courses, and the establishment of Internet teaching platforms. This research aims to provide a reference for improving course teaching.

articleTitle: An Empirical Model of Software Playability
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to demonstrate through empirical research that ISO/IEC 25000 Series SQuaRE and other existing software quality models, particularly those related to usability, are not suitable for special software products such as game software. Through the survey of university students in China, it shows that attribute such as Joy, Stimulus, and Novelty, are not included in the existing usability or playability models. However, these attributes are the most vital attributes of playability. In this paper, the usability and playability of software products are defined respectively as ‘how good the software is for using or playing’, or ‘how good it is to be used or played'. Since playing is a special form of using, so, playability is considered as a special type of usability. Other examples of using include working and studying. The empirical evidence in this paper demonstrates the usability in ISO/IEC 25000 Series SQuaRE is specialized for measuring how good the business application software can be for performing specific predefined tasks and to what extent. That is, if this deduction is correct, the usability of ISO/IEC 25000 Series SQuaRE is specialized for working, a special type of using, which is equivalent to workability. These discussions suggest that it may be impossible to develop a scale to measure the usability of all software. This means that to develop a scale of usability or playability with sufficient validity and reliability for practitioners to use, the software must be well segregated enough, and a separate measure must be developed for each type in detail.

Author Keywords: The International Standard Organization (ISO/IEC) 25000 Series Systems and software Quality Requirement and Evaluation (SQuaRE)

articleTitle: Research on the informatization reform of three education of Financial professional group based on the reform of Hybrid Teaching Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: This paper combs the mainstream teaching mode at home and abroad. Based on the hybrid teaching mode reform, it constructs the framework system and implementation path of the three education informatization reform of Financial professional group in higher vocational colleges, including the new ideas and new contents of teachers, teaching materials and Teaching methods.

articleTitle: Construction and Practice of Online Teaching Platform of Insurance Practice in Higher Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Affected by the new crown pneumonia epidemic, online education has become the main way for schools at all levels to carry out teaching activities. This is not only a test of my country's education informatization construction, but also a major opportunity to promote educational reform in the information age. Online teaching is a new teaching method in which teachers and students conduct online teaching and learning in a virtual classroom by building a teaching platform on the Internet and other networks. This article is based on a hybrid teaching model, constructs an online teaching platform of “Insurance Practice”, and combines the online teaching platform to conduct practical explorations of online teaching.

articleTitle: Research on Effective Reading Teaching Model for English Majors Based on Network and Information Technology under the Background of New Liberal Arts
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In 2018 Chinese University Teaching Forum emphasized the significance of the “Golden Course” and the determination of its construction of the Ministry of Education, and proposed to comprehensively advance the construction of “new engineering, new medicine science, new agricultural science and new liberal arts”. New liberal arts mean the new requirements and the new technology. This paper studies the reform path of reading teaching for English majors under the background of new liberal arts, discusses the effect of English reading teaching on the construction of new liberal arts for English majors, and discusses how to establish an efficient reading teaching model with the great help of the network and information technology, hoping to provide help for the construction of English majors under the background of new liberal arts in China.

articleTitle: Exploration and Research on the Teaching Reform Plan of Operating System Principle Course under the Background of New Engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Under the new engineering background, with the goal of improving teaching quality and cultivating application-oriented talents, the teaching reform is carried out for the course of operating system principle, introducing case teaching, strengthening practical teaching, reforming the assessment scheme, cultivating students' ability to analyze the underlying design of operating system and improving their professional quality.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Students' Satisfaction and Acceptance of a New English Course in Primary Schools Based on the Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the development of information technology into a new era, it was put forward in the national education reform and development of medium and long-term plan to strengthen the development of education informatization and to promote further integration of information technology and teaching. Under such background, this study explores the future possibility of blended learning in primary school by interviewing students and teachers to know more about their intention with the new learning and teaching mode. This possible blended pedagogical approach, refers to “online+ offline” approach, which relies much on the internet as an aid and complement, as well as challenge to traditional classroom teaching. It combines after-class online learning and in-class offline teaching with different emphasis of teaching objectives. It was also investigated in this study students' satisfaction and acceptance of the current English course, as well as a quantitative evaluation of the course effect. Basing on the result analysis of the questionnaire and interview, it was found that students were generally satisfied with the current course which had an apparent emphasis on the training English listening and speaking skills. Most of students accepted the current course, but they also look forward to the blended approach of language learning.

articleTitle: The Significance of Computer Music Teaching to Contemporary College Music Students
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, computer has become an indispensable and important tool in people's life. It has been applied to all kinds of industries in today's society, as well as in the field of music teaching. In recent years, colleges and universities have integrated computer music production technology into the teaching of music specialty, which not only makes up for the deficiency of traditional music teaching, but also stimulates students' interest in music and effectively improves the teaching quality. This paper will focus on the practical significance of computer music teaching in order to promote the deep integration of computer music technology and music teaching.

articleTitle: Research on Informatization of Educational Management Archives Based on Internet +
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In recent years, the “Internet +” technology has developed rapidly and rises rapidly. It mainly relies on Internet technologies such as big data, cloud computing, social networking, and search engines to realize a new network model of information integration and information intermediary functions. In terms of service innovation and carrier form innovation, the informatization of education management archives under the Internet + environment was discussed. The information technology of educational management archives under the Internet + environment is constantly updated with the social development and scientific and technological progress in the Internet era.

articleTitle: Exploration of university education reform based on mobile learning environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: This study analyzes the advantages and functions of mobile learning in college teaching under the hybrid teaching mode of adding mobile learning to conventional teaching. Examples show that mobile learning can make students more enthusiastic, more active and better learning effect. At the same time, it lists the shortcomings of mobile learning and gives the corresponding countermeasures.

articleTitle: How to Construct the Online Teaching Quality Monitoring System of Design Courses Driven by Data Analysis Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Big data and cloud computing technology play an important role in online teaching, educational data mining and learning behavior analysis. Taking environmental design as an example, based on the analysis of online teaching characteristics, this research uses the Delphi method to construct a digital monitoring system for online teaching quality of engineering design courses, and uses the analytic hierarchy process to determine the weights of the monitoring system indicators. Finally, the teaching data is extracted and quantitatively analyzed through online teaching empirical cases to verify the effectiveness of the monitoring system. The research results could provide technical reference for the monitoring and management of online teaching quality of engineering design courses.

articleTitle: Research on the influence of sports competition participation on College Students' social adaptability based on Excel software and SPSS statistical software
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: How to adapt to this changing pattern of the times tests every young man in the new era. Under the background of integration of physical education, based on the literature review at home and abroad, 669 college students were investigated by questionnaire survey and logical induction. The factors that influence the social adaptability of college students, such as gender, native place and frequency of participation in the competitions, were analyzed with independent-samples t test by using sports statistics and Excel software and SPSS statistical software and the single factor variance analysis method. It is concluded that participating in sports competitions can promote the cultivation of college students' team cooperation ability, adaptability and comprehensive ability.

articleTitle: Computer-Aided Translation Reconstructing the Development Concept of English Education in Higher Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In the era of information technology, Internet engineering technology has made unprecedented development. Computer network has important advantages in data communication, resource sharing and centralized processing. The integration of computer technology in English education in higher vocational colleges should conform to the development trend of the times and be an important guarantee to improve the teaching level and stimulate students' autonomous learning. This paper first analyzes the development background and application of computer aided translation. On this basis, in order to accelerate the application of computer technology in teaching practice, this paper reconstructs the English professional education model of higher vocational colleges from the aspects of subject education concept, student assessment system, teacher and student identity role. This research will provide reference for the reform and development of computer-aided English education.

articleTitle: Application of Computer in Mixed Teaching of Higher Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In today's society, because of the development of higher information education technology, computer technology is rapidly changing the learning methods and methods of college students. A variety of novel learning methods have also changed the learning concept and characteristics of college students. As an important part of university teaching curriculum system, higher mathematics plays a very important role in cultivating and developing students' thinking ability and creative ability. In order to improve the learning effect of the course and cultivate the students' active learning ability, some colleges and universities have carried out a new teaching method — mixed teaching on the basis of integrating online knowledge resources and offline educational resources. In order to further promote the development of the mixed teaching mode of “Advanced Mathematics ”, this paper takes the application of computer as the starting point, and through analyzing the concrete application of computer in each link of the mixed teaching mode, establishes the important position of computer in the mixed teaching, thus provides the direction for further promoting the development of the mixed teaching mode.

articleTitle: Meta-cognitive Strategies Based on Intellectualized Management System in College Listening Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Listening, as one of five skills of language learning, has been a problematic part of second language learning all the same. The study, based on the theory of meta-cognitive strategies and scientific strategies training based on Intellectualized Management System, proposes ways to improve learners' listening in second language learning after analyzing listening stages. The Intellectualized Management System consists of three major subsystems: running condition detecting system, condition decoding system and fault early warning notice system. The system can collect and assess the data of each student during the process of the listening practice through the first two decoding system. Students benefit from the data feedback of the system and in particular adjust their listening habit on the basis of the monitoring of the three subsystems, especially the fault early warning notice system, so that they can upgrade the listening comprehension combining with their meta-cognitive strategies.

articleTitle: Application of Flip Classroom in Computer English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the development of society, the traditional teaching methods and ideas are constantly changing. Flipping classroom has become a hot topic in the field of education, especially in computer English teaching. Flipping classroom is to make full use of modern computer network technology, put learning knowledge before class, internalize knowledge in extracurricular, thus forming a very high learning efficiency. In view of this, this paper explains the concept of flipping classroom, the basic mode and the difference between it and the traditional classroom. On this basis, this paper analyzes the current situation of computer English teaching, and emphasizes again the importance of flipping classroom in English teaching. Finally, this paper explores the application of flipping classroom in computer English teaching from three stages: preparation before class, strengthening in class and expanding after class, so as to provide innovative ideas for the teaching and development of computer English.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence Mechanism of Artificial Intelligence on Lateral Channel Spillover Effect
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With big data and artificial intelligence, we conduct the research of the buyers' identification and involvement, and their investments such as time, experience and consultation in various channels are analyzed and iterated. We establish a set of AI channel governance system with the functions of members' behavior monitoring, transaction clearing and deterrence; Through the system, the horizontal spillover effect of their behavior is controlled. Thus, their unfair perception can be effectively reduced and the channel performance can be improved as well.

articleTitle: Practice and innovation of teaching management in the post-epidemic era — Informatization Teaching Management
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The novel coronavirus pneumonia epidemic has brought many challenges to education and teaching, as well as new opportunities. The new crown epidemic has promoted the rapid development of online teaching. Online teaching is inseparable from the update and progress of information-based teaching management methods.
