Education management in China has entered the “post-epidemic era.” Based on the data analysis of the post-epidemic teaching questionnaire and multiple teaching management cases, this paper concludes that the new information-based teaching management is based on the combination of network technology and text, a combination of multiple teaching methods, and teaching technology and offline. Combination of information technology and teaching management, it can produce better teaching effect, increase flexibility and personalized teaching experience for teaching.

articleTitle: Construction of School Sports intelligence System under the Background of “Big Data”
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The arrival of the information age has fully penetrated and affected the structure and function of school sports, make school physical education also enter the era of “data facts”, changed the ecological system of school sports and accelerated the modernization process of school sports, at the same time, the reform of traditional thinking and behavior has caused school sports to face “broken window” challenges. In view of this, building a school sports intelligence system to guide and supervise students to participate in sports more scientifically and systematically is a problem that needs to be solved in school sports at this stage. The study uses big data as the link to construct the external model, internal model and integrated model of the school sports intelligence system, and analyzed the relationship between the various elements, and proposes that the promotion of the school sports intelligence system not only needs to strengthen the macro incentive policy, but also complete the big data sports think tank and build an open shared service platform suggest, and finally build a multi-level, high-quality school sports big data sharing platform.

articleTitle: Research on cloud classroom teaching activity evaluation system based on Vocational Post Ability
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Under the new situation of the continuous development of market economy, practical talents with the combination of theory and practice are urgently needed. As vocational colleges, it is the primary task to cultivate qualified and skilled talents with operation skills for the country In order to cooperate with the smooth development of practical teaching, it is very important to build an efficient and applicable practical teaching platform. However, the current MOOC, micro class and other platforms are mainly used for learning course knowledge, lack of ability training and skill evaluation. Combined with the new generation of electronic information technology such as cloud computing, it is of great significance to build a practical teaching platform integrating training environment simulation, ability training, process management and quality evaluation. This paper constructs the “ability map” of vocational post, develops the cloud platform of practical ability training, scientifically and intuitively reflects the students' learning effect, creates the evaluation model of students' ability curve, and realizes the objective evaluation of students' professional ability.

articleTitle: Research on Ontology Construction of Scenic Spots and Culture for Smart Tourism Based on the Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of the internet, information technology has been deeply applied in various fields of people's daily life. In the field of tourism, the mode of “internet + tourism” can meet the needs of tourists to quickly and accurately obtain valuable information from massive data. In this context, combined with the application and development of big data knowledge acquisition and ontology construction technology, an internet-based ontology construction method for scenic spots and culture is proposed. The ontology of scenic spots and culture constructed according to the method in this paper can represent and manage big data knowledge, which is helpful to extract cultural information of scenic spots from various data sources. It enables tourists to quickly obtain valuable information related to scenic spots culture from massive data and provides a foundation for intelligent application scenarios oriented to smart tourism.

articleTitle: Research on changes and integration of ideological and political education structure in universities in the era of computer network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology in today's era, information network has been better developed and popularized, which makes a new kind of information dissemination and reception gradually formed. The integration of information technology makes the ideological and political education structure of colleges and universities have changed significantly. Under this background, this paper takes the change of educational subject, educational object and educational environment in the the ideological and political education structure of colleges and universities as the breakthrough point, takes the information teaching as the foothold, from the educational idea, the idea, educational content and educational method, this paper probes into the integrated thinking of ideological and political education structure in colleges and universities. Finally, this paper will provide reference ideas for the reform and development of ideological and political education in colleges and universities.

Author Keywords: Ideological and Political Education in Colleges and Universities

articleTitle: Segmentation of Ultrasound Thyroid Nodules Based on Encoder-Decoder Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: This paper compares four ultrasonic segmentation methods of thyroid nodules. This research uses the encoder-decoder neural network structure to learn deeper semantic information in the down-sampling stage, gradually restore the position information in the up-sampling stage, and finally use skip connection integration features to complete the semantic segmentation of thyroid nodules. This paper tried four encoder-decoder structures on the ultrasound database of thyroid nodules. These experiments show that the structure is effective (maximum mIOU is 81.2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>).

articleTitle: Application of Computer Network Technology in College English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The innovation of computer network technology provides great opportunities for the development of various industries, and also makes college English teaching face many challenges. Based on the concept and characteristics of computer network technology, this paper fully reveals the problems of single teaching mode, backward method and limited evaluation mechanism in traditional college English teaching. In addition, by comparing the advantages and disadvantages of computer network technology in college English teaching, this paper puts forward some ways for computer network technology to act on college English teaching, then it will provide development ideas for college English teaching and college education reform.

articleTitle: The Effective Research of Computer Multimedia Technology in Auxiliary Higher Vocational Physical Education Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In this era of computer network technology, the combination of physical education and computer network technology can increase the interest and depth of the school in the process of physical education, which has aroused the attention of many people. There are also some sports researchers who link physical education with computer network, and they also explore the original ideas of physical education in the process of contact. Through the analysis of physical education in higher vocational schools, this paper explores the characteristics and functions of physical education. At the same time, this paper puts forward the difficulties faced by the integration of physical education and computer network technology. On this basis, this paper puts forward the countermeasures of physical education under computer network education, so as to further enrich and perfect the physical education teaching in higher vocational colleges.

articleTitle: Rethinking of Japanese Translation Ability in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The application of big data technology in all walks of life is getting more and more sophisticated. With the help of big data technology, the work at all levels has also got better development. Recently, Foreign Language Teaching and Research Press published the “International Guide”. In order to understand the compatibility between the realistic needs of current Japanese professional market for Japanese professionals and Chinese and Japanese translation ability standard in the “International Guide”, the author conducted study and investigation on the actual needs of the present domestic Japanese talent, and according to Grade 2020 Japanese translation curriculum training objectives of the university, the three were compared, and the results showed commonality but also differences in knowledge, ability and literacy. Under the background of big data era, combined with big data technology and related big data analysis, it is clear that the training goal of Japanese translation ability should be more Chinese and international, and there should be new thinking on the training approaches and methods.

articleTitle: Research on interactive technology of Webpage block localization based on JavaScript
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the development of web applications, the main way for people to obtain information is gradually transferred to the network. XPath can be used to uniquely represent a certain position in a web page for those who are familiar with web applications. However, it is difficult to interact with a computer to locate the content of a web page for most ordinary people who benefit from the web. Thus, we propose a webpage block localization technology based on JS scripts which is convenient for human-computer interaction. The experiments prove that it shows advanced performance both in interaction mode and block mode. Also, our scheme can be integrated with crawler technology to monitor a webpage block through the interaction of webpage block localization, and it can be applied to the problem feedback module of webpage to facilitate users' feedback and suggestions.

articleTitle: Research on the Application Feasibility of Digital Media Art in Red Cultural Tourism
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: As Bengbu is rich in red culture, red cultural tourism in Bengbu has become the precious resource and a way of red education. In the digital era, it is urgently necessary for us to cultivate the talents that can integrate media art and technology, apply immersive experience technology in the red cultural tourism, highlight the charm of red culture, attract the masses and especially realize the effective dissemination of the educational value of red culture among young people. In order to enhance the dissemination effect more effectively, it is necessary to make use of such digital media technologies as virtual reality technology and 3D panoramic technology to make important red culture bases and relevant exhibits displayed to the public, and take advantage of the interactivity of digital media to strengthen the immersive experience of the public.

articleTitle: Research On The Aesthetic Experience of Social Media Textual Language
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: After the public relations crisis, the endless roar of network public opinion brings great pressure of public opinion and economic benefit to the operation of social media. This paper discusses the public opinion of social media, which will highlight the concept of “user center” of social media, attach importance to the user value of social media, re-examine the “expected vision” of social media, pay attention to the “aesthetic experience” of social media, and improve the acceptance effect. Pay attention to social media aesthetic field and their own experience fusion.

articleTitle: “Digital Content + Blockchain” Create Value-Take ContentBox as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Blockchain is a new application mode of computer technology such as distributed data storage, point-to-point transmission, consensus mechanism, encryption algorithm, etc. In summary, it refers to the technology of collectively maintaining a reliable database through decentralization and trustlessness. Blockchain technology is not a single, brand-new technology, but the result of the integration of multiple existing technologies (such as encryption algorithms, P2P file transmission, etc.). These technologies are cleverly combined with the database to form a New ways of recording, transferring, storing and presenting data. Since its inception, the technological trend of blockchain plus the wealth effect has given people unlimited imagination and made the public crazy. However, its value can only be reflected after it is combined with commercial applications. This article starts with the classification of blockchain news, associates it with the significance of blockchain technology for news dissemination, and finally takes ContentBox as an example to explore how “digital content + blockchain” creates value.

articleTitle: Research on English Teaching Model Strategy Based on Computer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The 21st century is an information age, with the development of China's economic progress, computer technology as an auxiliary tool has been introduced into college teaching. In this paper, the characteristics and difficulties of computer English teaching are analyzed in detail. Combined with the application characteristics of computer information technology, the application orientation is regarded as the main reference in the optimization process of computer English teaching mode. At the same time, the optimization suggestions of computer English teaching mode are discussed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Physical Education Teaching Reform Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Carrying out college physical education under the background of “Internet +” can realize open teaching on the Internet and realize complementary learning. Through information technology, network interaction of sports resources, and knowledge precipitation can be realized, so that the supplement and extension of physical education training ground practice can be obtained, thereby improving the efficiency of college physical education. This paper compares and analyzes information technology and traditional education, and concludes that information technology has advantages and functions that traditional education technology can't match. The rational use of information technology in physical education can optimize the teaching situation, stimulate students' interest in learning and mobilize. Students are motivated to learn, and can effectively highlight the key points of teaching and breakthrough teaching difficulties.

articleTitle: Promoting the Governance Modernization of Higher Vocational Colleges under the Background of Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The governance modernization of higher vocational colleges is an important part of the national governance modernization. Internet information technology provides technical support and the guarantee for promoting the governance modernization of higher vocational colleges. This paper deeply analyzes the problems of student management in Higher Vocational Colleges under the background of Internet information technology, explores the countermeasures and measures of innovating student management and promoting the modernization of governance in higher vocational colleges, and helps to implement the modernization of national governance system and governance ability.

articleTitle: A Research and Analysis on the Demand of Blended Learner's Learning Support Service
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In order to analyze the demand of blended learner's learning support services, we conducted a questionnaire survey in a university. Empirical analysis results show that: blended learning satisfaction is positively and significantly related to learning support service; blended learners have a higher degree of demand for learning support services; female students have significantly higher demand than male students; non-history and art majors have significantly higher demand than history and art majors; the number of blended courses significantly affects the demand; but there is no significant difference in demand across grades. Therefore, according to the needs of learners, colleges and universities should enhanced awareness of learning support services, ensure investment, provide targeted support services, and construct evaluation systems to assess the quality of services.

articleTitle: Application and Exploration of Digital Construction and Information Technology in the Construction of Civil Architecture Specialty Group in Higher Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Digital transformation is an important way to promote the high-quality development of the construction industry. From “built in China” to “intelligent made in China” is the general trend of the development of China's construction industry. Its main sign is that information technology continues to be deeply applied to construction projects, and comprehensively promotes digital engineering and intelligent engineering. Therefore, colleges need to use the new generation of information technology to speed up the construction of high-quality digital talent team, and promote the construction of professional groups.

articleTitle: Short-video Design for Assignment Based on the Core Literacy of Senior High School Geography Subject: Take the Lesson of Landslides and Mudslides as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology and the proposed of the core literacy of senior high school geography subject, more and more video shooting technology and video resources have been applied to geography teaching. The effective integration of short-video and other information technologies into the process of geography teaching and the creation of an intuitive and vivid geography teaching environment are conducive to the cultivation of students' learning habits such as autonomy, cooperation and exploration, and the cultivation of geography core literacy. As a continuation of classroom teaching, geography assignment plays an important role in consolidating classroom knowledge, developing innovative ability of students and cultivating core literacy. The assignment completion time is relatively free and sufficient, and students have a high degree of participation, which is conducive to the use of short-video technology in the assignment process. Therefore, considering the requirements of core literacy of senior high school geography subject and the advantages of short-video technology, this paper attempts to design a short-video assignment for the lesson of Landslides and Mudslides and elaborates the design principles, processes and evaluation standard of the assignment. It is expected to promote students' knowledge mastery and core quality cultivation through this assignment. This paper aims to provide new idea for the cultivation of geography core literacy and provide a reference for the innovation of teaching methods of teachers in senior high school.

Author Keywords: Core Literacy of Senior High School Geography Subject

articleTitle: Exploration and practice of project teaching of dynamic website development based on PHP
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In the Internet era, there are many learning resources related to various courses or technologies, students' autonomous learning is becoming more and more convenient, and relatively speaking, project-based teaching resources that can cultivate students' project development ability are rare. As a server-side language, PHP plays a more and more important role in various website development, however, from the perspective of teaching, the existing curriculum resources and cases can not meet the needs of cultivating students' project development ability. Taking the online bookstore system as a teaching project, this paper puts forward the ideas and methods of project-based teaching reform. Around the realization process of the bookstore system function, the knowledge is explained. Through the project teaching, the students' project development ability and software engineering idea are cultivated.

articleTitle: Study on Pre-service Cultivation Mechanism of General Practitioners in Rural Primary Schools in Jiangxi Province
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The cultivation of students can not be separated from excellent teachers, Jiangxi rural areas should be underdeveloped economy, life is not perfect and other reasons, resulting in a shortage of excellent teachers. In this context, it is necessary to carry out pre-service education and training for general-practice teachers in rural primary schools. On the basis of analyzing the necessity of pre-service training, this paper fully investigates the present situation of teacher training in rural primary schools, so as to construct the feasible mechanism of pre-service training for general-practice teachers and contribute to the development of education in rural areas of Jiangxi Province.

Author Keywords: Primary school teachers in rural areas

articleTitle: Research on Blended Teaching under the background of Intemet+
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the advent of the era of “Internet +”, online teaching has made fundamental changes in college students' learning and teachers' teaching because of its significant advantages such as breaking through time and space constraints and free choice. Taking the course of data structure and algorithm as an example, starting from the online teaching needs, this paper deeply discusses how to effectively use the online platform and tools to carry out the course teaching. Combined with the college students' questionnaire, this paper analyzes the online basic situation, learning process experience, learning effect and existing problems, and puts forward some suggestions on the implementation of online teaching design. At the same time, it also puts forward some suggestions. It is explained that the mixed teaching mode will be imperative in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Teaching Application Category Based on Virtual Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: with the rapid development and its application in the field of education, virtual simulation technology has been paid more and more attention by educators. In order to solve the problem of how to correctly apply virtual simulation technology to solve the teaching difficulties, this paper explores the application categories of virtual simulation technology in teaching, divides five application categories and 13 sub categories, clearly gives the specific design ideas and application path of virtual simulation technology in teaching, based on which analyzes its application cases in the practical teaching.

articleTitle: Research on School-enterprise Cooperation Teaching of Accounting under the Integration of Production and Education Based on information technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The development of Internet information technology provides more choices for modern teaching methods and modes. The teaching method of accounting major has changed greatly with the school-enterprise alliance model. This article introduces that under the Internet information technology, enterprises can provide students with a real training environment through distance education, while the school provides enterprises with flexible labor reserve resources. The school-enterprise joint accounting teaching shortens the distance between teaching and application through this combination of industry and academia, and achieves a win-win situation for all parties. Finally, appropriate suggestions and future research directions are put forward for the teaching method of the integration of production and education.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Technology in the Teaching of Chinese Language and Literature Internet Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the progress and innovation of science and technology, information technology has become an important means of teaching reform and development. As a basic course in colleges and universities, the innovation of teaching mode and means has become an important channel for the cultivation of Chinese language and literature professionals. The application of information technology can make the teaching of Chinese language and literature more stereoscopic and vivid, not only improve the students' enthusiasm for learning, but also improve the teaching efficiency to a great extent and improve the teaching effect obviously. Therefore, this paper deeply analyzes the practical difficulties of information technology in the teaching of Chinese language and literature, and explores the concrete application methods of information technology in Chinese language and literature combined with the subject requirements of Chinese language and literature and the needs of talent training.

articleTitle: Can IT Investment Improve Customer Satisfaction? -Based on R Language
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Based on the contingency theory, this paper uses the panel data of 41 A-share listed companies in China from 2016 to 2019 to convert the product-level data from C-CSI database into enterprise-level data, and then extracts the listed companies involved by using fixed effect model and random effect model respectively. This paper analyzes the impact of information technology investment on customer satisfaction, tests the moderating effect of environmental turbulence and marketing intensity, and carries out a robustness analysis to ensure the reliability of the research results. The results show that: (1) IT investment has a positive impact on customer satisfaction. (2) Environmental turbulence negatively moderates the relationship between the two, but IT investment still positively affects customer satisfaction. (3) Marketing intensity positively adjusts the negative adjustment relationship between IT and CS caused by environmental turbulence. In short, increasing marketing intensity under the condition of environmental turbulence can alleviate the new negative adjustment caused by environmental turbulence. The conclusion of the study provides some experience for enterprises to make IT investment decisions under the current global situation.

articleTitle: Current Situation and Reform Countermeasures of Accounting Specialty Teaching in Private Colleges Under the Background of Online Education
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Accounting is the preferred hot major for private college students. The Covid-19 has promoted the large-scale application of online education and made the teaching of accounting produce new characteristics. The development of information technology puts forward higher requirements for the training of accounting talents, which requires accounting work to be changed from traditional financial accounting to management accounting decision-making [1]. Combined with the existing problems in the teaching of accounting in private colleges, we should find out the advantages and disadvantages of accounting specialty education under online education and integrate the link between online education and traditional education. From the aspects of the online educational resource management system, teachers' and students' information literacy, accounting professional virtual practice teaching platform, teacher-student relationship, and online teaching-learning evaluation mechanism, the advantages of offline education and online education are complementary. This paper puts forward a new idea of reform of accounting specialty teaching in private colleges under online education and creates a new accounting specialty teaching model.

articleTitle: Study on the education Integration of Art Design Specialty and Regional Characteristic Cultural Industry Based On Computer Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: As an information medium, computer technology not only connects art and culture, but also enables people to set up the future more freely while grasping the traditional design concept and cultural characteristics. The design of entering the information society is no longer a cold product, but an intelligent and humanized life must. The application of computer technology makes designers have better adjustment in knowledge structure, design program, vocational skills and so on, and more importantly, designers can give more forms of expression to design ideas and characteristic culture. In view of this, this paper takes the functional value of the integration of college art design education and teaching with regional cultural industry as the starting point, and explores the effective path of the integration from the aspects of market orientation adjustment, students' practical ability training, teaching content concretization and so on.

articleTitle: Competition and Development of Internet Finance to Traditional Commercial Banks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern network technology, many new technologies have sprung up in the era of big data, which means that Internet finance has been an indelible trend from its appearance to its gradual maturity. Of course, Internet finance has developed to the present, behind not only the efforts of the people, but also the continuous support and encouragement of the government and the state in policy. As a result, the “financial + Internet” model in the public unremitting exploration and innovation, showing an increasingly vigorous face. However, this has caused some conflict and competition to the development of traditional commercial banks. Based on the concept, characteristics and models of traditional commercial banks and Internet finance, this paper studies the competition and development of Internet finance to traditional commercial banks from the aspects of online payment, customer lending, personal finance and so on. It can be seen from this study that traditional commercial banks can make a better transformation with the help of the Internet, and at the same time, Internet finance can better solve their own risks and further improve the service system with the help of traditional commercial banks. This shows that there is a mutually reinforcing and mutually restricted relationship between the two.

articleTitle: Prospecting the Application of Computer in Ethnology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The 21st century is dominated by science and technology, ethnomusicology as an independent discipline, received the impact of digital wave. With the coexistence of opportunities and challenges, computers have gone deep into the application field of ethnomusicology and play an irreplaceable role. This paper expounds the beneficial aspects of computer and ethnomusicology, then analyzes the application of computer in ethnomusicology, and finally puts forward the problems and solutions in the development of ethnomicology. The application of computer plays an important role in ethnomusicology. The research of this paper will further broaden the application of computer in ethnomusicology, so that ethnomusicology can be developed with higher quality.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Information Management of University Electronic document in the Big Data Era
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: At present, China is rapidly moving into the Era of Data and big data will gradually become a part of the infrastructure of modern society. Moreover, the leading position and digitization of electronic document is becoming the basic support for the development of document management in Universities. Affected by big data, the work mode of document management in colleges and universities has changed and document information is digitized. Through survey data analyzing and program designing, we can find out the status of University Digital document Management and the electronic document problems in the work, which can provide a realistic basis for the research and practice of electronic document in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Research on Packaging Design of Bottled Beverage Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: This thesis aims to explore users' preference to packaging design of bottled beverage, and identify importance of relevant influential factors via AHP by taking packaging design of bottled beverage as the research object. Different types of packaging design of bottled beverage were evaluated and scored from the perspective of ergonomics to obtain weights of quality assessment indexes so as to provide references to further packaging design and improvement. The AHP first-level weight was 0.7 for vision and 0.3 for structure. Weights of the second-level indexes, including pattern, text, color, shape, material, opening mode, holding mode, drinking mode and carrying mode were 0.15, 0.16, 0.15, 0.11, 0.13, 0.06, 0.13, 0.06 and 0.05 respectively.

articleTitle: The current situation of English Writing Teaching in China Under the background of Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: This paper is the collection and arrangement searching through the Internet of the literature in the teaching of English writing from 2015 to 2020 in China. Nearly 200 articles on English Writing are rich and comprehensive in content, involving the layout before writing, the choice of words and sentences in the process of writing, the cohesion of texts and the revision of comments after writing. Especially with the development of big data and information technology teaching, some areas use English online writing system and evaluation system to improve writing efficiency. Finally, the author puts forward some suggestions on how to improve English writing.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Japanese Online Open Courses for Vocational Undergraduates Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The development of information technology provides rich solutions for the methods and models of modern education in colleges and universities. Online learning and VR technology have been widely utilized for the construction of Japanese courses in vocational universities. These technologies provide students a open platform for interaction learning which enhancing college students' cultural awareness and self-confidence. Finally, this paper concludes that current vocational undergraduate Japanese open course teaching status, and proposes corresponding solutions to the main problems. It is expected to provide a reference plan for curriculum teaching under the background of cultural confidence.

articleTitle: Dilemma and outlet of Public Security Management in Big Data Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of economy, informatization has become a trend of global development. Big data is used in public security management, which can manage public security efficiently, prevent related criminal activities effectively, and create an intelligent public security management mode, thus promoting the economic and social development of our country. In view of this, this paper analyzes the relevant connotation of big data, based on the current situation of public security management, analyzes the difficulties encountered by big data in public security management. At the same time, this paper further expounds the influence and function of big data on public security management. Finally, this paper discusses the innovative ideas of big data in public security management from the aspects of innovation consciousness, talent training and data disclosure.

articleTitle: On the Construction of a Monitoring System for Third Language Teaching Process Under the Full Credit System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In the past two decades, third language education has become increasingly important in various universities in China. In the curriculum of many universities, it is no longer just a compulsory second foreign language course for foreign language majors, but also gradually becomes a university-wide elective course for other non-foreign language students. The question of how to guarantee the overall quality of third language teaching has become a question of reflection for every foreign language department and an important issue for the sustainable development of foreign language teaching in universities. This paper analyzes the difficulties of teaching process monitoring in the context of a full credit system, applies the PDCA model of a quality management system to the management of third language teaching, and adopts measures such as reasonable use of information platform, test and evaluation means, and focus on feedback from multiple subjects in the two key monitoring stages of instruction and implementation (D) and inspection and evaluation (C), to provide a kind of reference standard for monitoring the process of third language teaching in colleges and universities. The aim is to provide a reference standard for monitoring the process of third language teaching in universities.

articleTitle: Research on Mobile Learning of College Students based on Wechat
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the advances of information technology, mobile learning on WeChat gets more popular among college students. With high accessibility and a large user base, WeChat gradually gathers more attention from mobile learning-related industries. Based on the Technology Acceptance Model, this paper introduced two external variables: user viscosity and social group to construct an improved TAM model. SPSS and AMOS were used to conduct fit analysis on the model. In an era of digital intelligence, only by making joint efforts from both internal and external sides, can we truly apply information technology to form new mobile learning education modes for College Students.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Mixed Learning Model for Applied Talents Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The demand and supply of talents are not balanced, and colleges and universities can not cultivate suitable talents resources for the society. To force the transformation of colleges and universities, the goal of the transformation reform is to train applied talents to adapt to the local economic and social development. The important link of the transformation is the reform of the training mode and the study mode. The study mode and the study effect of the students are directly related to the training quality of the applied talents. Blended learning mode is the combination of traditional classroom learning and information technology, it is the complement of online learning and traditional learning. Blended learning effectively promotes the efficient use of educational resources and makes the transfer of learning content unrestricted. Through the questionnaire survey and analysis, we provide a reliable research basis for the topic. Through the comparison of traditional learning and blended learning effectiveness evaluation, the data is summarized and analyzed, and the blended learning model can make up for the lack of personalized learning in face-to-face collective teaching and can solve the problem. Online learning encounters the problem of nowhere to ask for advice.

articleTitle: A Corpus-Based Comparative Analysis of the Readability of Chinese Textbooks Used by the Preliminary Schools in Mainland China and Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Combined with the relevant research on the readability formula, this paper determines nine measurement indexes according to the key factors affecting text readability, and makes a quantitative analysis of the primary school Chinese textbooks printed by People's Education Press and Taiwan Hanlin Press. The study found that in terms of Chinese characters, the two editions of textbooks performed better in the coverage of commonly used Chinese characters, and the PEP textbooks have higher requirements for children's literacy skills. In terms of words, the vocabulary richness of the THP textbooks is relatively stable, and the vocabulary distribution is strongly linearly related to grades, while the PEP textbooks lack a reasonable gradient. In terms of sentences, the THP textbook sets higher requirements for the comprehension ability of senior students.

articleTitle: A Study on Strategies for Postgraduates of Foreign Language Majors and Non-Foreign Language Majors from the Concept of Outcome-Based Education
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Chinese universities are reforming English education for postgraduates. The limitation of the reform, however, is that it only focuses on “non-English majors”. Foreign-language universities are comparatively different from other universities in the field of College English teaching and research. Postgraduate students in foreign-language universities include Foreign Language majors who take English as a second foreign language and Non-Foreign Language majors. Without considering their respective academic background, teachers may fail to achieve the expected teaching effects. This article will adopt an outcome-based education perspective to analyze the differences in the academic conditions of the two types of students, explore effective English teaching strategies for postgraduates of foreign language majors and non-foreign language ones, and summarize practical viewpoints of classified teaching.

articleTitle: Security of CORS on LocalStorage
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: HTML5 is the next generation of web application. Its LocalStorage solves some problems that can use cookies alone, but also brings new potential safety vulnerabilities because of using CORS. This paper discuss basic principle for using CORS in LocalStorage, compare several different cross-domain schemes, focus on existing security risks in CORS. A test case is designed for further analysis how to protect user privacy information, and put forward a practical scheme and some strategy on using CORS. Finally, a solution of using CORS is summed up, and also give some suggestions to security of CORS.

articleTitle: Timeliness in Group Counseling of Mental Health Education Curriculum in Computer Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the arrival of big data technology era, computer application technology is also developing. In order to make the healthy development of human society, the development of psychological education curriculum is very meaningful. And as a group counseling mental health education curriculum, its number of personnel is large. People introduce computer information technology into educational curriculum to improve the timeliness of mental health education curriculum in group counseling. The introduction of computer information technology and psychological education curriculum are combined. Their combination makes the educational curriculum more vivid and efficient, and the students' psychological character has been greatly improved.

articleTitle: Application of PID parameters optimization based on GWO in mould level system
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Mold level stability is a very important factor in the continuous casting process. To effectively control the liquid level at the set value, solve the problems of disturbance, nonlinearity, and time-varying in the system, as well as modeling difficulties caused by uncertain factors, and aiming at the shortcomings of conventional PID control, the gray wolf algorithm is introduced. The gray wolf optimization algorithm is used to self-tune the PID parameters, and the objective function is constructed based on the adjustment time and steady-state error of the mold liquid level system. Finally, the simulation and experimental results show that the algorithm optimization proposed in this paper is compared with the particle swarm algorithm, and the step response of the system is smoother. Gray Wolf optimized PID control has a fast response speed, with an adjustment time of 3.87s, which is lower than 13.46s for conventional PID control and 5.58s for the PSO algorithm. It can significantly improve the control accuracy and other performance indicators of the system. It provides a reference for improving the level control of the continuous casting mold.

articleTitle: A Study of the Effectiveness of Teaching English Writing for Chinese College Students from the Perspective of Engagement System in Appraisal Theory Based on SPSS 25.0
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the help of the samples T-test of IBM SPSS 25.0 and based on the comparison between the experimental class's and the native English writers' articles, this paper explores the effectiveness of teaching English argumentative writing in college from the perspective of Engagement System in Appraisal Theory. It is found that before the experiment, there are macro and micro differences in the engagement resource density between the experimental class's and the native English writers' articles, but after the experiment, these differences no longer exist, and the diachronic comparison of the experimental class's articles shows that this writing teaching mode has high effectiveness of promoting learning. This study can introduce a new method into the teaching of English argumentative writing, enable Chinese English learners to grasp the authentic English writing patterns, and contribute to the promotion of second language writing research.

articleTitle: Exploration of mixed teaching of engineering cost under the background of “Internet+”: —Take social students in higher vocational colleges as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In recent years, under the background of “Internet+” and the policy of expanding enrollment of one million, the number of social students in the expansion of enrollment has increased rapidly, which puts forward new requirements for mixed teaching. This paper first analyzes the problems existing in the current mixed teaching of social students of engineering cost in higher vocational colleges. Then, in the context of “Internet+”, the mixed teaching of engineering cost social students in higher vocational colleges is combined from the integrated design of mixed teaching, video design for pre-school and pre-class instruction, and combination of “asynchronous classroom and synchronous classroom” online teaching, exploring elasticity, flexible and diverse offline teaching, building a problem feedback mechanism, diversified all-round evaluation and assessment system, and the supervision system of blended teaching, with a view to cultivating highly skilled talents who integrate theoretical and practical knowledge for the society.

articleTitle: Text Classification Study Based on Graph Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Because the research of machine learning and deep learning so far has presented good results in the field of text classification, but it ignores the influence of words and words, and the relationship to a certain extent between words and documents on text classification in an overall perspective. Existing text classification researches are usually based on graph convolutional neural networks, in this paper, by using Mish() activation function to deal with the problem of experimental data in the hard zero boundary and by modifying the momentum of one-step moving average in the optimizer, a certain degree of improvement is proposed to the short-term memory problem after the optimization of experimental parameters, which is called LTM-TEXT-GCN. By comparison with Text-GCN, the experiment results demonstrate the effect of LTM-TEXT-GCN, and the improvement was 0.14%, 0.64%, 0.8% and 0.13% on the four data sets, respectively.

articleTitle: New Issues, New Features and New Trends in the Study of News Communication Law in the Internet Age
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of information age and Internet media, many kinds of new problems and cases have emerged in the research category of news communication law. It is widely known that, to study new problems, we need to explore new research methods and theories. This paper discusses the new problems of news communication law from the angles of privacy, forgotten right and copyright dispute, and systematically combs out the characteristics of news communication law. Finally, this paper discusses the development trend and innovative ideas of news communication law from the aspects of academic history research and new media technology, so as to further help the discipline construction and practical application of news communication law.

articleTitle: Numerical Algorithms On Non-Elementary Function
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: This paper discusses how numerical algorithms can be used to approximate a function using algebraic polynomials. With the two elementary methods, we try to estimate the given function as accuracy as possible. One of the methods is a very elegant numerical technique that has been widely used in applied mathematics such as numerical integration, etc. The other method is quite popular in statistical sciences and optimization. They both give some insights in approximating a function to algebraic polynomials without using too many advanced and complicated theories.

articleTitle: Research on the Cultivation of Accounting Personnel in Universities Based on AI
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In recent years, along with the rapid development of information technology, the impact of artificial intelligence on accounting become the hot spot. Artificial intelligence refers to the technology that can represent human intelligence represented by machines. AI will deal with daily accounting business according to specific accounting objects and work nature. As Tsinghua university decided to stop the admission of accounting in undergraduate enrollment plan, the discussion on accounting personnel's cultivation direction came into a climax stage and the transformation is in urgent need. Therefore, more cultivation models should be explored with IT, big data, cloud computing and artificial intelligence. Moreover, it is necessary to encourage teachers to step into the enterprises. Teachers should learn more about the social needs, in order to cultivate students to meet the needs of the time, and build a comprehensive teaching practice platform.

articleTitle: Improving EFL College Students' Metacognitive Writing Ability through Multimedia Software
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the influence of information technologies, EFL learning and teaching have experienced transformation. This study explores how multimedia software can be integrated into writing instruction to improve EFL college students' metacognitive writing ability. A comparative empirical research was conducted and narrative analysis was used to process 50 college students' reflection on their writing process. The Cognitive Academic Language Learning Approach (CALLA) was adopted with the help of multimedia software, such as QQ, Blog and i-Write. The findings of the study reveal that the students in the experiment group show a better metacognitive writing ability than students in the control group. Technology-supported metacognitive writing instruction can boost learners' writing motivation, confidence and improve their writing.

articleTitle: A Study on the Influence of Blended Learning on Oral Learning Motivation of Non-English Majors
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The digital age advocates the deep integration of information technology and education, and encourages teachers of all disciplines to actively carry out the mixed teaching combining online and offline. This study adopts a combination of questionnaire survey, interview and data analysis to conduct an empirical study on 200 non-English major freshman students in the university to explore the influence of blended learning mode supported by modern information technology on college students' oral English learning motivation. The research shows that the elements of blended learning model, such as situational awareness, learning resources, learning strategies, autonomous learning ability, teaching organization and evaluation form, enhance the dialogue and negotiation of learning, and can effectively stimulate the motivation of college students' oral English learning.

articleTitle: A study on the Relationship between Work Burnout and Social Support of Rural Middle School Teachers in Shaoguan Based on SPSS
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In order to understand the situation of teacher work burnout and social support in rural middle schools in Shaoguan, as well as the relationship between work burnout and social support, the “Teacher Burnout Questionnaire” and “Social Support Rating Scale” were used to survey 170 rural middle school teachers in Shaoguan City. Then, the social science statistical software SPSS20.0 was used to perform statistics and analysis on the obtained data. First, a descriptive statistical analysis of work burnout and social support of Shaoguan rural middle school teachers found that their work burnout is not serious. Some teachers have more serious work burnout, which is mainly reflected in emotional exhaustion; teachers' overall social support is better. Secondly, a correlation analysis of rural middle school teachers' work burnout and social support found that there is a significant negative correlation between work burnout and social support, indicating that teachers' social support can help alleviate their work burnout. Finally, according to the research results, some countermeasures are proposed to alleviate and prevent the work burnout of rural middle school teachers.

articleTitle: Research on Named Entity Recognition Based on Text Data of Beijing Subway Accident
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Safety is an essential theme of urban rail transportation. For the safety of urban rail transportation, the relevant companies have developed and implemented a large number of safety-themed services, these services generated a lot of business information. This information is unstructured data such as text, voice, graphics and image, and most of this information is based on text. Extracting valuable information which from a great deal of text is an effective using of data. In this paper, based on the acquired text of urban rail traffic accidents, text analysis technology is used to extract features, and a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF model for entity recognition in the field is constructed. The experiment selected almost 1,200 open source Beijing subway accident texts obtained by the crawler, and identified four types of entities such as time, site, route, and the causes of the accident. The results show that the constructed model can effectively identify the entities in the accident text and achieve good results. The accuracy, recall, and F1 value of entity recognition are 93.18%, 92.68% and 92.93%, respectively. Compared with LSTM-CRF model and BiLSTM-CRF model, the proposed model has certain advantages.

articleTitle: Research and Practice of User Learning Style Model Recognition Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The new education concept in the “Internet plus” era requires educators to focus on the personalized learning and development of users. Due to the massive learning resources in the network, it is difficult for users to make scientific choices according to their own learning characteristics and habits, resulting in low learning efficiency. How to use education big data analysis technology to provide accurate services for users, this paper uses big data analysis method to build user learning style recognition model, according to data preprocessing, big data key parameters fitting optimization, KNN algorithm to identify user learning style, and provide technical means for accurately pushing personalized learning resources and paths. Finally, according to the dynamic learning behavior data of users, based on the theory of Felder-Silverman learning style model, through the experimental comparison of two teaching classes, it shows that the research results can meet the learning needs, provide effective guidance for users, help to improve learning efficiency and promote personalized development.

articleTitle: Traffic Allocation Strategy Based on Reinforcement Learning in Two-layer Satellite Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In MEO-LEO satellite network, a MEO can establish connections with multiple LEOs at the same time. In order to maximize the use of satellite network resources, traffic allocation between MEO and LEOs is very important. This paper first describes the two-layer satellite network system model and point out the importance of traffic allocation among multiple LEO to MEO. Then, by quantifying the traffic resources that can be received by MEO and traffic requirements from multiple LEOs to MEO, and taking into account the remaining visible of MEO to LEOs, a traffic allocation strategy based on Q-learning in two-layer satellite networks was proposed, which aims to maximize the utility of LEOs to MEO in a given time. Then the paper grades the LEO traffic requirements to reduce the computational and storage complexity of the system. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed strategy is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: A Study on Continuing Education for Standardization Professionals in China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: This paper studies the needs and contents of continuing education for standardization professionals. Based on 392 standardization professionals questionnaires, 480 enterprise recruitment information, local organizations examinations in China and standardization literature, this paper analyzes the demands of education and requirements for professionals competence from the perspective of practitioners, enterprises and governments, and proposes a system of knowledge and skills for continuing education for standardization professionals. Network education is a more suitable form of continuing education for standardization professionals.

articleTitle: Landscape Design and Hakka Culture under the Background of Information and Digital Technology's introduction
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The emergence of information technology has brought people unexpected harvest and unprecedented experience. Through people's imagination and aesthetic ability, the use of computer graphics, hardware and software, human-computer interaction, digital model creation, multimedia expression and other ways, the landscape is reflected through the combination of digital and picture design. Hakka culture is a unique regional culture in China. Through carding and simplifying Hakka culture, this paper takes the planning scheme of the Hakka Scenic Area of Tiandong Group in Ninghua as an example to try a new mode of inheriting and applying the Hakka culture under the background of information technology, in order to achieve the purpose of carrying forward the Hakka culture.

articleTitle: Precision Supply of Informatization for Innovation and Entrepreneurship Education: Mechanism of Action and Path of Implementation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The current problem of unbalanced supply and demand in innovative entrepreneurship education, and the global enabling function of information in big data era, give a new vitality to the supply-side structural reform of this education. This paper constructs the model of the precision supply docking subject of mass entrepreneurship and innovation education by constructing the “service information platform” and distinguishing the various subjects of the supply side innovation of mass entrepreneurship and innovation education. This paper analyzes the mechanism of informatization to promote the innovation of this education, and finally puts forward the path of informatization to promote the implementation of precision supply of this education.

articleTitle: Practice and Thinking of Music Education in Computer Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: With the development of science education, computer also plays an important role in music creation. Computer music creation has become a musical style. Computer not only changes the means of music technology, but also changes the way of creation in the field of education, enriches the form of computer music creation and improves the scope of creation. Computer music creation has obvious advantages for breaking through the existing music style, which is also the focus of computer creation research. This paper explores the background of music education in computer network, and deeply understands the process of educational practice and the problems of thinking.

articleTitle: The impact of blockchain on media: Take Bilibili as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: In the Internet era, high-quality original content often faces the problem of being stolen and plagiarized. As one of the largest user content production communities in China, copyright protection has become a huge problem for content creators in www.Billblll.com (Hereinafter referred to as ‘Bilibili’). The characteristics of Blockchain technology is decentralization, non-tampering and traceability, which can help the platform to ensure efficient and reliable content confirmation, and escort the copyright management of creators. This article is going to explore the copyright protection of original content of Bilibili and the feasibility of the future business model of Bilibili under blockchain technology.

articleTitle: Research on the strategy of deep integration of professional construction and information technology industry development in Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The development of vocational education is inseparable from the deep integration with industrial development. However, there are many difficulties in the integration of industry and education, such as the lack of motivation and willingness of many domestic enterprises to participate in vocational education, the insufficient ability of vocational colleges to provide services for industrial development, and the different operation mechanism between the education system and the industrial system. This paper constructs the overall framework of “Industry Education Alliance + industry college + professional group” to create a new ecology of industry education integration. Under the “ecosystem” of the industry Education Alliance, relying on the industrial college, the paper constructs the model of technical skills convergence and social service of large and small enterprises. Through data analysis, we found that it can improve the social service ability of vocational colleges, and provide an effective scheme for the deep integration of vocational education and information technology industry development.

articleTitle: Exploration and Practice of Intelligent Educational Accomplishment of Computer Majors in Vocational Colleges in the Era of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The rapid development of artificial intelligence technology has put forward new requirements for the quality of the people. As the main force of national skilled talents, students of vocational colleges have become the main force of researching technical skills. The integration of intellectual literacy into the study of technical skills has become a major issue that urgently needs to be solved. The intelligent literacy training of computer majors in vocational colleges will play a leading and exemplary role in popularization. By investigating the status quo of the development of artificial intelligence in various industries and analyzing the talent demand report, the following four aspects are given to strengthen the cultivation of its intellectual literacy. One is to extend the development of each course to the application and popularization of artificial intelligence technology. Cultivate knowledge and theoretical knowledge; the second is to strengthen the design and training of “artificial intelligence programming thinking” to cultivate intelligent thinking. The third is to strengthen the study of big data information security and improve the security awareness of artificial intelligence. The fourth is to strengthen smart training and promote the learning and application of smart technologies. And integrated into the project-oriented teaching of typical job design, put forward the integration path of artificial intelligence technology and computer major in vocational colleges in talent training positioning, curriculum system and teaching mode.

articleTitle: The Integration of Spirit of Combating the COVID-19 Epidemic into Ideological and Political Education in Universities under the background of Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: College students are aboriginals on the Internet, and the Internet has become an indispensable part of their lives. The spirit of combating the COVID-19 epidemic is a contemporary concrete manifestation of Chinese spirit in the context of major public health emergencies, and a great spirit tested by practice. Integrating the spirit into the ideological and political work of universities is good for strengthening students' ideological guidance. This paper studies the promotion of spirit of combating the COVID-19 epidemic in the Internet environment by means of literature research and questionnaire survey. The conclusions are as follows: under the Internet environment, the ideological and political work in universities should change the concept, make good use of the new media resources. The spirit of combating the COVID-19 epidemic should be ran through in the daily life, be three-dimensional, vivid, and be integrated into practice to promote action, so as to become the spiritual power of students' growth and success.

Author Keywords: spirit of combating the COVID-19 epidemic
ideological and political work in universities

articleTitle: Application of Fanya Network Platform in Blended Teaching of Basic Fashion Design
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The Fanya network platform covers integrated teaching design, teaching resource application, teacher-student interaction, and teaching effect analysis. Aiming at the shortcomings of traditional teaching methods, this paper conducts research on the application of Fanya network platform to courses of basic fashion design. In terms of teaching design, each unit inserts 6–8 minutes of micro-lecture videos to allow students to preview in advance; teaching resources are integrated into video resources such as fashion conferences, and the video accounts for 22.22% of teaching resources; teacher-student interaction is set up for classroom online rush answer and checkpoint games to increase students' interest in learning; the teaching effect analysis platform integrates all data, teachers monitor the teaching effect in real time and adjust the teaching progress and teaching methods in time. Students learn the course content through online and offline methods, and study the course of the target class the blended learning on the Fanya network platform accounts for 77.27% of the total score of 80 points or more, which effectively improves the teaching quality of basic fashion design courses.

articleTitle: The Ambiguity Study of Time Conceptualization in Russian Cultures from the Perspective of Computational Linguistics and Pragmatics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: eliminating potential language ambiguity is one of the most important tasks in the application of Computational Linguistics and artificial intelligence education research. At present, the problem of combining pragmatics, artificial intelligence education and Computational Linguistics has not yet been solved in academia. The concept of time plays an important role in the study of Philosophy, Linguistics and even various disciplines. The author tries to sort out the existing theories of Computational Linguistics and pragmatics. In this paper, the author uses the theory and model of Computational Linguistics and pragmatics, and then experimentally analyzes the ambiguity of Russian words in temporal semantic groups. At the end of this paper, the author summarizes several principles and specific methods for eliminating language ambiguity, and the author also explains how to apply these theoretical research results to the teaching of artificial intelligence education.

articleTitle: Teaching Application of Economic Management Course based on Modern Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Information technology is a kind of compound initiative element. Nowadays, people have generally affirmed the important position of information technology. As a powerful means, it has led education to a new revolution. In the current trend of rapid development of information technology, how to combine with education to improve the practical ability, application ability, independent ability and innovation ability of economic management talents has become the focus of all major education practitioners. Using the methods of literature research, document investigation and statistical analysis, this paper puts forward the key elements of the integrated application of information technology and economic management course from the theoretical and practical aspects, and systematically discusses the relationship between the methods, steps, implementation of information technology and the teaching purpose of the subject.

articleTitle: Firm Information Technology Protection under Risk Preference Asymmetry
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: When firms share knowledge about information technology, the co-opetition relationship between the knowledge sender and the knowledge receiver often induces opportunistic behaviors, which leads to intellectual property risk. Each firm's perception of the other firm's risk preference affects each firm's judgment of the other firm's risk control effort, and then affects each firm's opportunistic behavior. Considering the risk preference is private information, and the firm disclosing false risk preference or the firm distrusting the risk preference disclosed by the other firm will be punished, this paper uses evolutionary game theory to analyze the equilibrium of the game between two information technology sharing firms when they disclose and process risk preference information. This paper finds the method to achieve the maximum benefits of two firms, the best effect of information technology protection and the optimal decision-making integrity. This paper contributes to the research on information technology protection.

articleTitle: A Study on the Practicality of Virtual Reality Technology in the Teaching of Photography in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Objectives: The relationship between the image and reality has been changing throughout the process of the continuous evolution of the image. It has become an existence that the image has been changing from covering of reality to the initial representation of reality, from virtual reality to the complete invasion of reality. People can virtually understand and experience reality through the construction of the real world through photography. Then the real world can become a constantly changing image on the screen. Therefore, the challenges facing photography art today must be the technological innovation and the thinking of the new artistic dimension produced by contemporary images. Therefore, photography education in colleges and universities is facing many difficulties and challenges in the digital era. From traditional photography to digital photography, it is a worth thinking question that educators should go through a process of adaptation or transformation. Methods: By analyzing the characteristics and advantages of VR technology, taking “technology as the starting point”, it is proposed to integrate VR technology into the study of photography and discuss the practical role of VR technology in the photography course. Then summarizing “virtual simulation” and other scientific and technological means Impact on teaching. Results: VR technology can create a simulated teaching environment, improve the problem of the weak practicality of existing courses, and provide a training environment and concept that matches the communication environment. Through immersive experience to improve students' digital literacy combining the three abilities of information communication, visual literacy and applied technology. Entering photography teaching in colleges with technology can expand the breadth of photography teaching, transforming photography teaching from skill learning to talent training, and from photography professional technology learning to digital literacy cultivation. Conclusions: In the context of converged media, many virtual images and digital technologies are used in the creation and expression of images. The expansion of three-dimensional space, the interaction of VR technology, and the appearance of immersive sensory experience have expanded new directions and ideas for photography education in colleges. Through the feasibility analysis of the integration of VR technology into the university photography teaching and the study of the value of “technology” in the development of science and technology and social transformation. I am trying to explore the importance of virtual reality technology in photography education. Eventually, photography education will maintain a dialogue with the times in the progress of technology in the digital age.

articleTitle: Research on operation and development prospect of urban intelligent parking system
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
