abstract: Intelligent parking refers to the service based on parking resources, combined with wireless communication technology, mobile terminal technology, GPS positioning technology, GIS and other technologies to collect, manage, query and arrange urban parking spaces. Intelligent parking can help car owners get free parking information and automatically pay the parking fees of surrounding parking lots, maximize the use of parking resources, maximize the profits of parking lots and optimize the parking services of owners. The core of intelligent parking is to optimize and integrate the resources of the parking lot, realize the sharing of offline parking resources through the mobile Internet, gradually eliminate the island phenomenon in the parking information system, and improve the utilization rate and user convenience of the parking lot. By using smart parking technology, traffic congestion can be reduced by 30%, invalid traffic flow reduced by 12% to 15%, and the time to find parking space can be shortened by 6 to 14 minutes, so that the government, enterprises and the public can achieve a win-win situation. In the future, we put forward the overall solution of the city, which can be summarized as: overall integration, dynamic and static combination, upper and lower combination, and industrial integration. There is still a long way to go to eradicate the “stubborn disease” of urban parking, which will be a process of continuous exploration. It needs further close communication and cooperation among the government, industry enterprises and communities, hospital associations, property associations and other users to jointly seek a more optimized solution.

articleTitle: A Review of Research on Technology Enhancing Chinese Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: The development of technology has spawned more and more researches technologies promoting Chinese learning. In order to systematically analyze the research situation of this field, we use content analysis to review 40 relevant documents published in 2016–2020 on the topic of technology enhancing Chinese learning, and draw the following conclusions: (1) Most researches use quantitative and qualitative methods in their researches. (2) The most frequent topics are learners' language ability and learning emotion. (3) Learners always use iPad, mobile phone and computers in Chinese learning, and the most frequently used is the iPad, which is more convenient and easy to control, suitable for learners of different ages. The most frequently used software is the learning platform such as wiki platform, Moodle platform, 3D virtual environment learning platform and mobile seamless learning platform developed by the researchers themselves. These platforms are mainly used to create a contextual learning environment for learners or to support learners to read and write. Teaching games such as Second life, sifteo cube games, AR games, and VR games are also noticed in these papers. In addition, digital tools such as e-books, online communication software (such as forums, WeChat, QQ) always be used to promote the interaction between learners to enhance language learning. (4) The primary school research objects are mainly first language learners, while the university research objects are mostly second language learners.

articleTitle: Research on promoting the construction of Medical Association in X province based on big data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: From the overall strategy to the medical field, it has become a national decision to promote the development of big data in the medical industry. Under the promotion of big data, the construction of medical alliance will form new formats, new ideas and new development. In the past three years, the average growth rate of digital medical users was as high as 30%, and the users' attention to digital medical topics increased more than 11 times than that before the epidemic. However, in terms of remote consultation, there are still few doctors and it is difficult to pay. The penetration rate of scene is only 21%, and the penetration rate of online drug purchase is 31%. At present, the penetration rate of disease management scenarios is only 8%. Patients with chronic diseases and severe diseases have high demand for disease management services, but the penetration rate of the former (about 10%) is much lower than that of the latter (20% - 30%). The construction of Medical Association Based on big data is to fully mobilize the existing resources of specialty, unite with influential discipline institutions, carry out the cooperation of medical teaching and research discipline construction, and improve the basic medical ability. Therefore, we need to promote a series of work, such as the establishment of standardized training system for specialists, the establishment of industry consensus, standardized diagnosis and treatment, and the establishment of promotion standards, as well as the integration of remote consultation, two-way referral, and resource allocation through IT and big data.

articleTitle: A Study on the Portuguese Translation Strategies of Culturally Loaded Words in “Frog” from the Perspective of Manipulation Theory - Based on the comparison of machine translation and manual translation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: As artificial intelligence and big data develop, machine translation has made big strides in terms of translation quality, language coverage and knowledge acquisition. And it has the great potential to replace manual translation. Therefore, the speech that machine translation dominates the world is on the rise. While, for Chinese literature, whether it can be “going out” successfully ou not. Firstly, it is necessary to clarify how to make foreign readers understand the culturally loaded words in Chinese literature. Therefore, the author analyzes the Portuguese translation strategy of culturally loaded words in Frog.

articleTitle: Application of BIM Technology in Exhibition Complex Project of China Expo
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: BIM Technology has become an important emerging technology in the field of architecture in the context of China's building industry to information technology. This study introduces the current status of BIM technology in the construction phase, and points out the existing problems in the implementation, combined with the application of BIM Technology in China Expo and Exhibition project to reflect the depth and breadth of the application of BIM technology in the construction phase, summarized the advanced experience and found the deficiencies; on this basis, the improvement measures and the development direction of BIM technology in the construction phase of our country are put forward, so as to provide theoretical results for the study of BIM in the construction application.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on the Use of Pictures on the Front Page of People's Daily Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: Nowadays, society is experiencing the baptism of visual culture, the symbolic technologies carrying news information are becoming increasingly diversified, Pictures have become the most influential visual language for information dissemination in the new era, and news pictures that serve as an important element in newspaper layout, have unique communication effects. Taking People's Daily as the main body, this paper studies the application of front-page news pictures by content analysis method, objectively, systematically and quantitatively describes the sampled information, analyzes the application characteristics of front-page news pictures, and puts forward constructive improvement strategies for their shortcomings.

articleTitle: School Effects of Father Presence on Middle School Students' Academic Performance: A Hierarchical Linear Modeling Analysis Based on CEPS Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Internet, Education and Information Technology (IEIT)
abstract: As an important environmental factor in family education in China, the class effect of father presence on middle school students' academic performance is unclear. The impacts on students' academic performance are based on the 2014–2015 tracking data of the China Education Panel Survey (CEPS), and a hierarchical linear model was used to explore the school effects of father presence on middle school students' academic performance in terms of the type of father presence. The study found that: students' self-efficacy had a significant effect on individual academic performance, and self-efficacy was a positive predictor of achievement; father involvement in parenting was classified as physical presence, disciplinary presence, and emotional presence; and father involvement had a significant positive effect on middle school students' academic performance. Specifically, the improvement of spatial presence and emotional presence had a positive impact on middle school students' academic performance, while disciplinary father presence had a negative impact. Based on previous research on influencing factors of individuals, campus, and peer groups, the finding of school effects of father involvement is an important basis for family education improvement.
